premise.premise: A child builds a simple invention to solve a small problem at home. The first try goes wrong in a funny way, and a change makes it work.

item.title: Raj and His Machine
item.passage: Raj made a machine so he could pick up socks. He built the clever machine with a red box. The red machine could move around the room. It worked very well at first. Then the machine tried to carry a big ball. It dropped the ball on the mat. Raj added a net because it dropped a ball. Now the machine could hold everything carefully.

questions.evidence: He built the clever machine with a red box.

questions.evidence: Raj made a machine so he could pick up socks.

questions.evidence: Raj added a net because it dropped a ball.

item.title: Kofi's Cat Machine
item.passage: Kofi wanted to feed his pet cat with a machine. He used a box and a bottle to make it. First, the food fell on the floor because the box was too small. His cat sat by the machine and watched. Kofi had a clever idea to fix it. The machine worked the second time because Kofi moved the box up. The cat was happy and ate the food.

questions.stem: What did Kofi use to make his machine?
questions.evidence: He used a box and a bottle to make it.

options: Because the box was too big
Because the box was too small
Because the box was too old
